appearance_facts.fact: A bold black title reads 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023'. This text is positioned above the chart area.
The y-axis is labeled 'Recovery Score' and displays tick marks for values 0, 400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, 2,000, 2,400, and 2,800. The scale increases from bottom to top.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and displays tick marks for 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
A single solid blue line represents the data. It begins at the 2018 mark near the 2,800 level.
The line slopes downward from 2018 to 2019, reaching a local minimum at the 2019 mark, which aligns with the 2,400 grid line.
The line slopes upward from 2019 to 2020, reaching a local maximum at the 2020 mark that is slightly above the 2,800 grid line.
The line slopes downward from 2020 to 2021, ending at a level between the 2,400 and 2,800 grid lines, appearing closer to 2,600.
From 2021 to 2023, the line is nearly flat, maintaining a constant level slightly above the 2,400 mark.
